decision: held: none of the three meta-analyses (31135916, 38913392, 41693488) has open full text, so saffron preparations, doses and included trials cannot be verified. From the abstracts, 41693488 (34 RCTs) finds only self-reported scales improved (BDI, BAI) with no clinician-rated benefit, 31135916 shows publication bias, and 38913392 compares with SSRIs (equivalence wording Dr. Pham rejected). OA retry 2026-10-28: 31135916 bronze copy is behind a Cloudflare bot check; 38913392 and 41693488 closed.
summary: 31135916: 23 RCTs, large effects versus placebo on depression (g 0.99) and anxiety (g 0.95) with publication bias. 38913392: 8 SSRI-comparator trials, no significant difference. 41693488: 34 RCTs (1769 participants); BDI WMD -4.39 and BAI -5.06 with I2 >92%, no effect on HDRS, HARS or POMS.
